algorithm: LCFR experiment: instantaneous sampled regrets and own-reach strategy sums weighted by global iteration t; uniform baseline exactly matches v1.3.

criteria.rationale: Diagnostic product tolerances: 1 percentage point mean / 5 points maximum movement; 0.01 BB per dealt hand. Not a multiplayer Nash theorem. Verified requires a certified full-deck BR upper bound and independent audit.

conclusion: No statistically established equilibrium improvement. Strategy movement and raw sampled regret are diagnostics; fixed fitted gains are not true best responses. Conservative selection may retain baseline for every seat and then measures zero, which is no convergence evidence.
statistics: Per reported family only, ideal IID PRNG assumption. Paired EV and fixed-deviation differences use independent score deals. No joint confidence guarantee across all seeds/checkpoints/families. No true exploitability upper bound.
limits: Rare histories and response fitting uncertainty
Normal raises, limps, postflop, ICM excluded
